verdict.rationale: PayPal's agent toolkit explicitly exposes create_refund/get_refund tools that programmatically initiate and query refunds, and refunds are also covered by the general REST/dispute APIs and webhook event notifications for tracking status changes. However, evidence does not tie refunds specifically to agent-placed orders (cart API, Store Sync orders) in an end-to-end documented flow, and there's no dedicated refund-tracking dashboard/API example beyond the generic get_refund call. missing for 10: an explicit agent-order-to-refund linkage/example, dedicated refund status tracking beyond get_refund, independent hands-on confirmation of refund flow.
